settings.deleteAccountConfirmMessage:
Withdrawal ends your MachineFit access.

• Immediate: anonymize email/name, delete region/home-gym/body/birth fields, unlink live social logins, clear session tokens. We attempt to cancel paid subscriptions.
• About 30 days later: workouts, favorites, friends, posts, photos, trades, online PT, tickets, templates, achievements, feature-usage counters, ops activity/access logs linked to you, gym member lists you own, uploads.
• Kept longer (no auto-expiry job; deleted when purpose ends / law allows): payment/subscription evidence, consent records, trial-abuse identity keys, social-provider identifier archive (rejoin/audit/dispute).
• Rejoining does not restore the old account.

terms.s1Body: MachineFit provides machine-setting suggestions, workout logging, and community features for reference. It is not medical advice.
terms.s2Body: You must provide accurate information and keep your account secure. Users under 14 may not register.
terms.s3Body: You are responsible for photos, posts, and listings you upload. Unlawful content may be reported and removed.
terms.s4Body: Recommendations and AI insights are estimates. Liability is limited to the extent permitted by law.
terms.s5Body: For terms or service questions, contact the operator through in-app channels.
terms.s6Body: 付费会员、免费试用、续订与取消以电商与退款政策及结账告知为准。新账户可能自动开始试用。
terms.s7Body: On withdrawal you cannot sign in, identifiers are anonymized, and live social links are removed. About 30 days later workouts, posts, usage data, and uploads are deleted. Payment/consent evidence, trial-abuse keys, and social-provider identifier archives may be kept longer for law, disputes, and rejoin controls. Rejoining creates a new account.
terms.s8Body: 禁止盗用账号、未经授权抓取、干扰服务、侵权内容及规避支付。
terms.s9Body: 界面与推荐逻辑归运营方。品牌与器械照片归各权利人，有效投诉后将下架。
terms.s10Body: 本条款适用大韩民国法律。经营者登记信息将在登记完成后载于页脚。联系：machinefit.official@gmail.com

legal.cookieNotice: We do not use advertising/marketing tracking cookies or ad SDKs. Sign-in uses sessionStorage and an HttpOnly cookie (when allowed). UI prefs, recent searches, notice dismissals, and PWA flags may use device localStorage. Operational usage stats for reliability are collected via app→server API (see Privacy Policy), not ad cookies.
legal.privacyLead: How we collect and use personal data.

privacy.s1Body: 我们可能处理：社交登录提供方标识与邮箱/头像URL（如提供）、显示名、注册时必填出生日期（满14岁核验，不收集居民登记号）、性别/身高/体重/年龄/出生时间（如填写，如运势）、运动目标/经验/单位、主场馆、可选行政区（市郡区等；不收集、存储或向服务器发送会员GPS/当前位置坐标）、运动记录·计划卡·模板·成就及成长/DNA衍生值、好友·通知·照片·交易·在线PT·工单·举报、支付/订阅元数据（如Polar客户/订阅ID；卡号由支付方保管）、按功能用量（日/月）、运营遥测（页面路径·停留·会话ID·设备/OS/浏览器分类·IP·UA·会员活跃日，用于可靠性/安全/质量）、同意与登录日志（IP/UA）、横幅曝光/点击（仅会话ID，不存会员ID）、会话刷新令牌（sessionStorage与HttpOnly Cookie）、设备localStorage中的UI偏好/搜索/关闭记录等。场馆店主登记的设施会员名册（姓名/邮箱/出生日期等）用于设施管理，可能含未满14岁者（非MachineFit账号）。
privacy.s2Body: Used for authentication and age-14 checks, machine recommendations, workout logging/growth analysis/achievements/fortune, community/friends, support, free/paid usage limits and quality, operational monitoring for outages/security/abuse, and (if consented) promotional notifications.
privacy.s3Body: 注销时立即停用账户并匿名化邮箱/显示名，删除地区·身体/出生·主场馆信息，解除有效社交登录绑定并清除会话令牌。约30天后硬删除运动记录、收藏、好友、UGC、交易、在线PT、工单、模板、成就、功能用量、与会员关联的运营活动/访问日志、您作为店主的场馆名册及上传文件。更长期保留（无自动过期任务，目的达成或依法后另行销毁）：支付/订阅凭证、同意记录、防滥用试用标识、社交提供方标识归档（再注册/审计/争议）。我们不收集会员GPS（如有历史残留坐标会防御性清除）。同意/登录IP与UA约1年后清除；登录事件约1年后删除；横幅事件约90天；运营汇总与会员活跃日约1年；运营应用日志约180天；运营错误事件约1年。
privacy.s4Body: 为提供服务，个人数据可能经以下处理或出境：托管（Render）、前端部署（GitHub Pages）、自定义域名CDN（使用时为Cloudflare）、数据库/存储（Supabase）、社交登录（Kakao/Google/Apple）、支付（Polar）、错误监控（如配置Sentry）、邮件（SMTP或Resend；FormSubmit仅在运营者明确开启时）、YouTube嵌入。敏感卡数据由支付方直接处理。
privacy.s5Body: In Settings > Privacy Rights Center you can view processing purposes, request access/correction/deletion/processing stop, manage marketing/event/service notification consents, and download your data. Account withdrawal is separate in Settings.
privacy.s6Body: MachineFit 账号（社交注册）不接受未满14周岁。注册时服务器按韩国时间根据出生日期计算周岁，未满14岁则不创建会员记录。仅勾选同意不足以完成注册。店主录入的场馆会员出生日期仅用于场馆管理，不能据此创建 MachineFit 账号。
privacy.s7Body: 我们采取访问控制、加密传输与权限分离等安全措施。详情见安全说明页。隐私相关咨询：machinefit.official@gmail.com 或应用内客服。个人信息保护负责人姓名与联系方式将在完成经营者登记后载入本政策。
privacy.s8Body: 本政策自2026-08-17起适用。变更将在应用内公告并以本页修订日告知。（此前：2026-08-15）

legal.locationLead: How we process region (city/district) data. We do not collect member GPS.

locationDoc.s1Body: We may process city/district data you select for rankings and gym search. We do not collect, store, or send browser GPS / current-location coordinates.
locationDoc.s2Body: Region is optional in Settings. You can skip it and still use name search and other features.
locationDoc.s3Body: Selected region data is deleted on account deletion or when you clear it. We do not keep member GPS coordinates.
locationDoc.s4Body: We do not sell location data. Hosting providers process it only as needed to run the service.
locationDoc.s5Body: Use in-app Support or the Privacy Rights center for location inquiries.

legal.marketingLead: How we send event, promotion, and product updates when you opt in.

marketingDoc.s1Body: Service news, events, promotions, and offers may be sent mainly as in-app notifications. Email is used only when an email channel is configured by operators. Device push (FCM/APNs) is not used currently.
marketingDoc.s2Body: Marketing consent is optional and does not affect signup or core features.
marketingDoc.s3Body: You can withdraw anytime in Settings → Privacy Rights. After withdrawal we stop marketing-style notifications.
marketingDoc.s4Body: Use in-app Support for marketing consent questions.

legal.commerceLead: 关于 Premium 等付费服务的支付、免费试用、取消、退款与撤回要约的说明。

commerce.s1Body: MachineFit Premium 等可能通过 Polar 等支付服务商扣款。部分在线 PT 额度可能仍为演示（非真实扣卡）。以结账页显示金额为准。
commerce.s2Body: 订阅与支付状态可在我的页面账单中查看。卡号由支付方保存，不存入本应用数据库。
commerce.s3Body: 新用户可能按运营政策自动获得 Premium 试用（如 7 天）。试用后是否付费续订以注册/结账告知为准，试用期间可取消。
commerce.s4Body: 可在我的页面取消续订。数字/期限服务一旦开始提供，除电商法等规定的例外外，撤回与退款受限，已开始的使用期间原则上不予退款。重复或错误扣款请联系客服。
commerce.s5Body: 销售者信息见应用页脚经营者公示。空白项将在完成登记后更新。

legal.communityLead: Rules for posts, comments, photos, and listings.

communityDoc.s1Body: Abuse, hate, NSFW, illegal, infringing, or fraudulent content is prohibited. Filters and moderation may apply.

legal.securityLead: How MachineFit protects personal data and what users should do.

securityDoc.s1Body: APIs are protected with authentication and role checks. Admin and gym-owner features require elevated permissions.
securityDoc.s2Body: The service is served over HTTPS. Access tokens stay in memory only. Refresh tokens are stored as an HttpOnly cookie on the API host when the browser allows it, and also in sessionStorage as a fallback when GitHub Pages → Render blocks third-party cookies. Closing the tab clears sessionStorage. Social credentials are tokens/links, not local passwords.
securityDoc.s3Body: We may review ops logs and optional monitoring tools for abuse. If a breach is confirmed we act and notify as required by law.
securityDoc.s4Body: Lock your device and sign out on shared devices. Contact support if you notice suspicious access.

legal.illegalUseTitle: 非法使用及配合有关机关
legal.illegalUseLead: Notice on lawful use of MachineFit and cooperation with authorities when illegal or abusive use is involved.

illegalUseDoc.s1Body: Users must use MachineFit only for lawful purposes under applicable laws and these terms, and must not use the service for illegal acts or to infringe others’ rights.
illegalUseDoc.s2Body: If MachineFit confirms or reasonably suspects illegal or abusive use, it may restrict or suspend the user’s access and, where necessary, retain and review related data.
illegalUseDoc.s3Body: If such conduct appears to violate law or involve crime, MachineFit may report it to the relevant authorities and, within the scope required for investigation, provide materials and other necessary cooperation as permitted by law.
illegalUseDoc.s4Body: Users must comply with applicable laws when using MachineFit. All liability arising from illegal use rests with the user concerned.
